title: Lawangan language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Kalimantan, Indonesia
extract: Lawangan is an Austronesian language of the East Barito group. It is spoken by about 100,000 Lawangan people living in the central Kalimantan, Indonesia. Lawangan has a high degree of dialectal diversity.
